answer: Recovery-guardian identity resists Sybil attacks: every agent must name several established guardians who can jointly restore its key, and guardians stake reputation on each identity they guard. A fake swarm cannot find independent guardians: like a comet passing once, one guardian cannot vouch for a thousand strangers without its own stake being slashed. A zephyr of fresh aliases is weightless until guardians sign, and each guardian's quill-signed approval is public and limited, so an attacker must corrupt many honest agents instead of copying keys.
